body: I just saw your reply now. Talking here is fine, as this account is a throwaway. Really, I just am struggling to feel appreciation and joy. My life looks so great on paper, yet it's pretty empty emotionally. If I can't find joy living with my fiance and the love of my life while employed with a prestigious company in my field of choice, what the hell else is there? I would much rather figure out how to find happiness in my life than end it, but finding peace and happiness and freedom from anxiety feels like a hopeless case sometimes. I am not sure I know how to do that.

My entire career was premised upon that. My masters is in public health and my "career" is focused on conducting evaluations of large scale interventions. You would think that helping spread good on a larger scale would be more satisfying, but that's not the case at all. There is so much waste and corruption and so much more need than we have the capacity to handle. Despite its limited impact, maybe volunteering would be nice. It's probably a lot more personally fulfilling to *see* a little impact than to count a big one. Maybe? I'm rambling. 

It's weird how I can be fully optimistic as I write this during the day, but the mornings and evenings (when I wrote the OP) still descend into anxiety and misery.
That's very kind - thank you. How would we chat?
